ID GIVE 0 STARS IF I COULD
Oct 2026 • Couples
Absolutely disgusting experience. I would avoid Sky Cafe Fastfood (Sky 1). We ordered a Vietnamese coffee with milk, a coconut coffee, and pho. When our order arrived, my partner’s coffee was literally only half full, which was disappointing enough. What completely ruined the experience was watching one of the male staff members repeatedly pick his nose in full view of customers and then continue touching things around the food service area without washing his hands. I believe he may have been the person who prepared our coffees, although I can’t say for certain whether he touched the food. Other staff members clearly noticed what he was doing and were laughing about it. Watching this happen while we were sitting there with food and drinks we had just ordered was absolutely revolting and made us question the hygiene standards of the entire place. At an airport cafe serving hundreds of travellers, basic food hygiene should be the bare minimum.
One of the most disgusting food service experiences I’ve witnessed. Please avoid

Terrible service overpriced warm flat beer
Apr 2025 • Couples
Terrible service very few food options even at 2 pm. Apparently they had run out of a considerable selection. We ordered four beers but when delivered one was warm and flat. We requested for it to be exchanged. They refused and then put it in the fridge for two minutes. Unfortunately the magic fridge didn’t create a cold fizzy beer after two minutes! We requested a refund but that was refused also, stating that we had drunk half the beer despite us taking the beer in the cup and the bottle as proof that only a sip was taken. Avoid at all costs unless you like overpriced warm flat beer and poor service. Wish we had read the other reviews before trying here.
